response_text:
26. (Currently Amended) A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document, the document having a drawing order that indicates the order in which the primitive graphic elements are drawn when the document is displayed; calculating a first value for a first primitive graphic element and a second primitive graphic element that is subsequent to the first in the drawing order, wherein the first value is calculated based on __a spatial relationship between the first and second primitive graphic elements__; and based on the comparison of the first value to other values calculated for additional primitive graphic elements that are subsequent in the drawing order, defining a single structural graphic element within the document from the first and second primitive graphic elements __only when the first value satisfies a predetermined threshold condition that is distinct from size-based metrics alone__.

27. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value is __a spatial proximity value or a relative positioning value__.

28. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value represents __a spatial distance or relative positioning of a smallest bounding box that encompasses the first and second primitive graphic elements__.

31. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the set of instructions for calculating comprises a set of instructions for calculating a different value for each pair of primitive graphic elements subsequent in the drawing order, wherein the set of instructions for defining the single structural graphic element comprises sets of instructions for: using the calculated values for pairs of primitive graphic elements to identify clusters of primitive graphic elements as candidates for joining as compound graphic elements __based on spatial relationship criteria__; and identifying sequences of primitive graphic elements within a cluster whose bounding boxes __intersect or satisfy a predetermined spatial proximity condition__; and joining the sequences as single graphic elements.

32. (Currently Amended) A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document; based on values calculated for pairs of primitive graphic elements __that reflect spatial relationships between the primitive graphic elements__, defining a set of successive primitive graphic elements as a candidate compound graphic element; using bounds of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more subsets of primitive graphic elements within the set __based on spatial proximity analysis__; and defining each particular subset having more than one primitive graphic element as a single structural graphic element within the document, the structure graphic element comprising the primitive graphic elements in the particular subset.

33. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 32, wherein the set of instructions for defining the set of successive primitive graphic elements comprises performing __spatial relationship analysis or cluster analysis based on spatial proximity__ on the calculated values.

34. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 32, wherein the set of instructions for using bounds of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more subsets of primitive graphic elements comprises sets of instructions for: selecting a first graphic element in the cluster and assigning the graphic element to a new sub-cluster; assigning a second graphic element in the cluster to the sub-cluster when a bounding box of the second graphic element __overlaps or is within a predetermined spatial proximity distance of__ a bounding box of the sub-cluster.

35. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 34, wherein the set of instructions for using bounds of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more subsets of primitive graphic elements further comprises a set of instructions for assigning a third graphic element to a second sub-cluster when a bounding box of the third graphic element __does not overlap and is beyond the predetermined spatial proximity distance of__ the bounding box of the sub-cluster.

36. (Previously Presented) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 34, wherein the bounding box of the sub-cluster is an intersection of the bounding boxes of all primitive graphic elements already in the sub-cluster.

37. (Currently Amended) A method for analyzing a document, the method comprising: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document, the document having a drawing order that indicates the order in which the primitive graphic elements are drawn when the document is displayed; calculating a first value for a first primitive graphic element and a second primitive graphic element that is subsequent to the first in the drawing order, wherein the first value is calculated based on __a spatial relationship between the first and second primitive graphic elements__; and based on the comparison of the first value to other values calculated for additional primitive graphic elements that are subsequent in the drawing order, defining a single structural graphic element within the document from the first and second primitive graphic elements __only when the first value satisfies a predetermined threshold condition that is distinct from size-based metrics alone__.

38. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 37, wherein the first value represents __a spatial distance or relative positioning of a smallest bounding box that encompasses the first and second primitive graphic elements__.

39. (Cancelled)

40. (Cancelled)
